topic: Burnout: flat after a break says more about the work (single)
caption:
Feeling flat soon after a break can say more about the work than about your rest.

The World Health Organization describes burnout as a work problem, the result of chronic workplace stress that has not been well managed. When exhaustion comes back after rest, it is information about what you went back to, not proof you rested badly.
